title: Trending on TikTok & Instagram
dek: What is actually selling and spreading on TikTok and Instagram this fall, each with the dated report behind it.

boards.title: TikTok's best sellers
boards.dek: Chart-toppers on US TikTok Shop this fall, by Kalodata's monthly sales counts.

boards.title: Beauty the feed is buying
boards.dek: Holiday sets, hot tools and K-beauty skincare selling on TikTok Shop this season.

boards.title: Gadgets and gear
boards.dek: Power, cleaning and play gadgets near the top of TikTok Shop's charts.

boards.title: Home, toys and games
boards.dek: A viral frozen-drink machine, a best-selling vacuum and the toys and games selling for the holidays.

items.name: Smooth & Clear Body Care Set
items.why: A Korean body-care kit for rough, bumpy skin that was the top-grossing product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with about 150,000 sets sold that month per Kalodata. FastMoss also ranks it first for the third quarter, at roughly $9.6 million in sales.
items.ebay: medicube smooth clear body care set

trend.note: The No. 1 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 and across Q3.

items.name: The Dreamer Blanket
items.why: A plush throw blanket. Net Influencer, using Kalodata figures, ranked it the No. 2 product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 with $2.56 million in sales, after also placing second in August.

trend.note: A top-two TikTok Shop product in both August and September 2026.

items.name: SLUSHi Professional Frozen Drink Maker (FS301)
items.why: An 88 oz countertop slushie and frozen-drink machine. Net Influencer ranked it the No. 4 product on US TikTok Shop in August 2026, with $2.1 million from about 6,440 units (Kalodata data).

trend.note: No. 4 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in August 2026.

items.name: DELTA 3 Classic Portable Power Station (1024Wh)
items.why: A 1024Wh battery power station for outages and camping. Net Influencer ranked it No. 8 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with $1.59 million from 3,980 units at an average of about $399.

trend.note: No. 8 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in September 2026.

items.name: Nex Playground Active Play System
items.why: A motion-camera game console for active family play, no controllers. TikTok's newsroom and Modern Retail both report it sold more than 25,000 units on TikTok Shop last year, and TikTok names it a gaming standout for this holiday season.

trend.note: Named by TikTok as a holiday 2026 gaming standout after 25,000-plus TikTok Shop units last year.

items.name: Beachwaver Pro Rotating Curling Iron
items.why: Beachwaver's flagship rotating curling iron. Modern Retail reports the brand sold more than 1.1 million units on US TikTok Shop in one year.

trend.note: The brand sold 1.1 million-plus units on TikTok Shop in a year.

items.name: Express Your e.l.f. 24-Day Advent Calendar
items.why: e.l.f.'s 2026 makeup and skincare advent calendar. Modern Retail reports it had sold more than 2,500 units on TikTok Shop by Oct. 20, early in the holiday season.

trend.note: 2,500-plus units sold on TikTok Shop by late October.

items.name: You Know You Love Me Collector's Set
items.why: A holiday makeup set with two clay palettes, two mascaras and Maracuja Juicy Lip products. Modern Retail reports it has sold more than 1,700 units on TikTok Shop, where Tarte has sold 8.6 million units since 2023.
items.ebay: tarte you know you love me set

trend.note: 1,700-plus units sold on TikTok Shop this season.

items.name: Honey Oud Eau de Parfum
items.why: A low-priced unisex honey-and-oud perfume. Net Influencer ranked it No. 5 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, with $1.73 million from 87,520 units at about $19.79, and fifth in August too.

trend.note: A top-five TikTok Shop product in both August and September 2026.

items.name: Cordless Pressure Washer Gun
items.why: A battery handheld pressure washer for cars, decks and driveways. Net Influencer ranked it No. 6 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 ($1.67 million) and No. 3 in August (about 71,000 units at roughly $32).

trend.note: A top-six TikTok Shop product in August and September 2026.

items.name: POP Tromsø Collection Spicy Bundt Nice Travel Body Kit
items.why: A travel-size body kit from e.l.f.'s first fragrance and body-care line, a limited holiday drop inspired by Tromsø, Norway. Modern Retail reported the POP Holiday Tromsø Collection sold more than 2,100 units on TikTok Shop, with one creator video near 750,000 views.
items.ebay: elf pop tromso spicy bundt nice kit

trend.note: More than 2,100 units of e.l.f.'s POP Holiday Tromsø Collection sold on TikTok Shop by Oct. 20, 2026.

items.name: Essential Eyelash Serum, Jumbo 0.5 fl oz
items.why: A Korean peptide-and-biotin lash conditioner that ranked seventh on US TikTok Shop in September 2026, at about 83,000 units and $1.6 million in sales per Kalodata. It is prostaglandin-free, the ingredient behind most lash-serum irritation complaints.

trend.note: No. 7 by revenue on US TikTok Shop in September 2026.

items.name: Magnesium Complex 8 Elemental Magnesium Supplement
items.why: A capsule that combines eight forms of magnesium, including glycinate, citrate, malate and taurate. Net Influencer ranked it No. 9 on US TikTok Shop in September 2026 ($1.57 million from about 100,950 units), and FastMoss put Toplux Nutrition at No. 10 among all TikTok shops by units sold in October.

trend.note: No. 9 product on US TikTok Shop in September 2026; its maker was a top-10 shop by units in October.

items.name: Classic Clog
items.why: Crocs' original foam clog, rated 4.5 stars across more than 28,000 reviews on its own site. Net Influencer ranked the Crocs shop No. 7 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in October 2026 ($10.14 million from about 208,600 pairs at an average of $48.61, close to the Classic Clog's price), and FastMoss counted it No. 18 by units.

trend.note: Crocs was a top-10 shop on US TikTok Shop by revenue in October 2026.

items.name: Cemenrete Picotonic Shot Cream, 0.88 oz
items.why: A face cream from Dr.Melaxin's Cemenrete calcium line, sold at Target. Net Influencer ranked Dr.Melaxin No. 3 on US TikTok Shop by revenue in October 2026 ($10.31 million from about 413,500 items at an average of $24.93), and FastMoss put it No. 2 by units, second only to medicube.

trend.note: Dr.Melaxin was the No. 3 shop by revenue and No. 2 by units on US TikTok Shop in October 2026.

items.name: Navigator Deluxe Upright Vacuum (NV360)
items.why: A corded bagless upright that has been around for years and still sells: Net Influencer, using Kalodata figures, ranked it No. 7 on US TikTok Shop in October 2026 with about $2 million in sales and 10,300 units.

trend.note: No. 7 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in October 2026.

items.name: Glossi 2-in-1 Blow Dryer Brush (HT302)
items.why: A hot brush that dries and smooths in one pass. It was the No. 10 product on US TikTok Shop in October 2026, about $1.9 million in sales on roughly 14,000 units, per Net Influencer and Kalodata.

trend.note: No. 10 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in October 2026.

items.name: EGF NAD+ Firming Serum
items.why: A face-and-neck firming serum from the brand that runs TikTok Shop's top-grossing US store; it was the No. 8 product in October 2026, about 88,000 units sold.

trend.note: No. 8 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in October 2026.

items.name: PDRN Silky Sunscreen Stick SPF50+ PA++++, 20 g
items.why: A K-beauty SPF stick that was the No. 2 product on US TikTok Shop in October 2026, with $3.7 million in sales. Sold here by Dodo Skin, a Korean beauty shop that ships to the US.

trend.note: No. 2 product by revenue on US TikTok Shop in October 2026.

items.name: Stickerbox Voice-Powered Sticker Maker
items.why: A kids' gadget that turns a spoken idea into a printed sticker to color. FastMoss ranked it the No. 13 toy on US TikTok Shop in October 2026, about $250,000 in sales; the current batch is on preorder, shipping by Dec. 1.

trend.note: A top-15 toy on US TikTok Shop in October 2026, per FastMoss.

items.name: Color Stack Challenge
items.why: A fast color-matching stacking game for two players, ages 8 and up. FastMoss had it at No. 7 among TikTok Shop toys in the week of Nov. 2, 2026.

trend.note: No. 7 toy on US TikTok Shop in the week of Nov. 2, 2026, per FastMoss.
